settings.title: Echora Settings
settings.languageHint: Choose the language for the Echora interface. It is saved on this device.
settings.currentThemeHint: Switch the player and stage mood colors instantly
settings.reduceMotionHint: Keep the lyric cues while softening background drift, carousel, and looping glow; currently: {{state}}.
settings.glowBlurQuantizeHint: Draws the per-word glow as a compositor filter instead of an animated text shadow. Chromium sets aside a little shared memory for every new shadow radius and never gives it back, so on Linux the renderer runs out after roughly 35 minutes and the picture freezes while the audio keeps playing. On by default on Linux; the glow looks nearly, but not exactly, the same.
settings.generateEyebrow: Generate a stage for this song
settings.generateHeading: Let Echora design a stage for the current song
settings.withLyricsContext: Will use available lyrics and song mood
settings.songInfoContext: Will build the stage mood from song info
settings.playFirstTitle: Play a song first, then design its stage
settings.playFirstHint: You can try the sign-in-free showcase tracks first, then decide whether to connect your own music.
settings.useGeneratedColorsHint: Generated by AI; not required for normal playback.
settings.playbackVolumeHint: Mute is a flag, not a zeroed level - your last volume survives a reload.
settings.volumeShortcutHint: Inside the stage use ↑ / ↓ for volume and M to mute
settings.spectrumHint: Audio always comes first; this only says whether the stage can read the real spectrum. Remote sources that refuse measurement fall back to a rhythmic pulse.
settings.spectrumIdle: No local track has been played yet, so the analysis path is unknown.
settings.spectrumAnalyser: Audio is routed through the analyser and the stage reads the real spectrum (source: {{reason}}).
settings.spectrumDirect: Audio stays on native output and the stage uses a rhythmic pulse (reason: {{reason}}); sound is unaffected.
settings.aiServiceHint: The service key is used server-side only and never appears in the browser, URL, or codebase.
settings.agnesMissingHint: Ask the deployment admin to finish service setup, then redeploy.
settings.agnesUnavailableHint: Check that the service is deployed, or try again later.
settings.agnesConfiguredHint: Prompts only include the current song's title, lyrics, or instrumental status; private playlists are never sent.
settings.generating: Designing a stage for this song…
settings.previewReadyHint: {{name}} · Apply it to the stage once you like it.
settings.sourceCodeHint: Echora is licensed under AGPL-3.0. The source for this version is on GitHub.
settings.openSource: Open the source for this version
settings.privacyHint: When you sign in to YouTube or Spotify, access tokens stay only in this device's browser. Echora never sees your password. Signing out clears local tokens; recent playback and lyric offsets also stay only on this device.
settings.obsEnableHint: Send the live lyrics stage to an OBS browser source or another window.
settings.obsTransportHint: A relay reaches any browser; the channel only reaches this browser.
settings.obsOverlayUrlHint: Paste into an OBS browser source (1920x1080, transparent).
settings.obsTokenMissing: Set a token and start the relay with the same one.
settings.obsHttpsHint: An https page may reach a loopback http relay; keep both on this machine.
